reuse.why: All linking handlers share the new orchestration and existing bank/sync helpers, although Fintegra's downloader copies Akahu's implementation.

duplication.why: The change removes substantial linking duplication and shares local unlinking, but adds another copy of transaction request, error handling and response mapping.

placement.why: Link orchestration, provider downloads, server configuration and model declarations remain in their established layers.

scope.why: The edits directly support the requested linking rules, replacement operation and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking improves ownership, but unrestricted Partial overrides, untyped account fields, string provider identifiers and a mutating assertion weaken the helper contracts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider linking handlers use linkBankAccount, and replacement and ordinary unlinking both use clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadAkahuTransactions with provider substitutions and a slightly reshaped retVal declaration.

abstraction_drift.where: The replacement rule adds replaceExistingLink and its refusal-versus-clear branch to shared linking validation; every provider continues through that definition.
